yaml:
flow:
  - id: dev
    name: Dev
    kind: agent
    model: default
    skill: otaq:work-ticket
    description: "Builds what the ticket asks for, with its tests, and commits it: every ticket that changes the code needs it."
  - id: validate
    name: Validate
    kind: check
    by: agent
    model: default
    skill: otaq:validate
    rounds: 3
    description: "Checks the work against the ticket and runs the project's checks, so what Dev missed is caught before anyone reviews it."
  - id: review
    name: Review
    kind: check
    by: you
    description: "The user reads the change and passes it, or sends it back with what to fix: their say before it is delivered."
delivery:
  delivers: pr
  mode: click
  model: codex:gpt-5.5
  effort: medium
  instructions: Keep the title under 70 characters.

start_from.foot: Replaces the stages between Backlog and Done, and how work is delivered. Shipped flows use the default model of the tools on this Mac: what your account is set to. Change any stage after. Nothing changes until you save.

ask.placeholder: Ask Noyan to change this flow…
ask.line: Proposes a draft · nothing changes until you save

watch.label: Watch a ticket
watch.title: Watch a ticket go through
watch.subtitle: the draft, not the saved flow

passes.name: Backlog
passes.text: It waits in Backlog until you start it; Start puts it into the first stage.

passes.name: Dev
passes.text: default works on it in Dev with otaq:work-ticket.

passes.name: Validate
passes.text: default checks it in Validate and passes it.

passes.name: Review
passes.text: It waits in Review for you: you pass it, or send it back to Dev with a note.

passes.name: Done
passes.text: You approve it and a pull request opens; it is done once it is merged.

fails.name: Backlog
fails.text: It waits in Backlog until you start it; Start puts it into the first stage.

fails.name: Dev
fails.text: default works on it in Dev with otaq:work-ticket.

fails.name: Validate
fails.text: Validate fails it once, so it goes back to Dev with default’s notes. After 3 fails in a row it would wait for you.

fails.name: Dev
fails.text: default fixes it in Dev and it comes back to Validate.

fails.name: Validate
fails.text: default checks it again in Validate and passes it.

fails.name: Review
fails.text: It waits in Review for you: you pass it, or send it back to Dev with a note.

fails.name: Done
fails.text: You approve it and a pull request opens; it is done once it is merged.

saved.title: Flow saved
saved.text: Applied now. Tickets that haven’t reached a changed stage follow it; tickets in it or past it finish as they are.
